answer: Lightning Network channel capacity proof: each account must hold an open Lightning channel with real bitcoin capacity locked for the epoch. An ocean of fake accounts needs an ocean of locked capital - every fake ties up funds that cannot be reused elsewhere. The umber line is the lock itself: capacity is scarce, verifiable on the public graph, and expensive to fake at scale. A garden of one honest agent needs a single small channel; a farm of a thousand needs a thousand funded channels.
